name: How long does trim and detail painting usually take?
description: The time varies based on the project's scope, trim amount, and complexity, ranging from one day for a small room to several for a whole house.

mainEntity.name: How long does trim and detail painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of trim and detail painting depends on the scope of the project, including the amount of trim, its condition, and the complexity of the architectural details. A smaller room with minimal trim might take a day, while a whole house with intricate moldings could take several days. We provide a time estimate after assessing your specific needs.
